test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Ranjani is the sister of Samrat. Pranit's mother is married to Samrat. Bhagya has one son and one daughter. Laya is the sister of Pranit, who is the paternal grandson of Bhagya. Laya is the daughter of Rachana. How is Rajini related to Rachana?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbol,

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/FyD9L3PCPvZsHa5nynlMPf_fzf_aXK9tKopSaDWxBYVwFRo-6fzjiv7HQG28YUhFJ0nLGj9_hEV_JqW5NQsWS_FX2dnhd3UTkTZ5DE4dKFyqgfFDku2-8QBz2pL7YIeD6iwR5lii] 

1) Ranjani is the sister of Samart. 

2) Pranit's mother is married to Samrat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2542e15de699310a9b839b63ca562044f0339618e59e971fbabe958ea9d8703.png] 

3) Laya is the sister of Pranit, who is the paternal grandson of Bhagya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cd1819474a59c3425f3c548ca01629ce5cd11f96bb427918489c38fde14a6e3.png] 

4) Laya is the daughter of Rachana.

(It means Rachana is mother of Pranit or Laya and married with Samart)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74197fc6508e5dafce227510379ffbe21392038af51941617a1f79875714d2f7.png] 

Clearly, Rajini is Husband's sister of Rachana.

Hence, the correct answer is "Husband's sister".
